top_signals.title: Kentucky Derby Operator Taps Loan Market to Refinance Debt
top_signals.summary: Kentucky Derby operator Churchill Downs Inc. is seeking to raise $500 million to refinance existing debt as maturities loom, adding to a rush of firms tapping the market for risky loans.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Robinhood Chain’s rapid growth is being driven by 4 key factors, analyst says
top_signals.summary: The chain’s TVL has climbed to nearly $1 billion since its July 1 launch, while daily DEX volume reached $1.88 billion Sunday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
